decisions.reason: As a valve-related pipeline component very close to the firm's existing fittings and infrastructure customer base, it fits its knowledge and production capabilities well and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.

The pipe bracket extends the established metal fabrication offer and can be supported by the firm's welding, coating, and custom-production know-how, though it is somewhat more standard and thus slightly more at risk than core pipeline components.

The pipe support bracket builds directly on the firm's existing fabrication and project-customer knowledge, giving it good scope to learn from early market feedback and improve it rather than drop it.
